title: Request a supplier payment
intro: Choose the invoices and an approved destination, review the exact terms, then send a request to an independent approver.
approveIntro: Review retained requests and current invoice balances before recording an independent approval.
allocationHelp: Select invoices and enter an amount for each. Available amounts include recorded payments and net credits. All allocations must use the same currency. A preview does not reserve funds.
documentHelp: Use the retained payment instruction that the reviewer can access. A link alone does not authenticate its author or approve this request.
file: Choose the retained file to calculate its hash
fileHelp: The file stays on this device. Only its SHA-256 is retained with this request. Maximum 20 MB.
fileLarge: Choose a file no larger than 20 MB.
hashFailed: The file hash could not be calculated. Retry or paste the hash of the exact retained document.
noSuppliers: No matching active supplier is available. Adjust the search or complete supplier setup.
noDestinations: This supplier has no approved destination. Complete the bank-change approval process before requesting payment.
pendingDestination: A destination change is awaiting approval. Resolve it before requesting payment.
noInvoices: No eligible invoice is available for this supplier. Check invoice approval and posting first.
reviewHelp: Confirmation rechecks authority, destination and current source balances. If they change, review again.
requestEffect: Confirmation records your request for independent approval. It does not release payment.
approveEffect: Confirmation approves the retained request. Release and reconciliation remain separate steps.
notSettlement: A request or approval is not proof of payment settlement. Check release and reconciliation records for that outcome.
pending: A confirmation may already have been recorded. Keep the same request reference and retry to recover its current outcome before starting another.
passwordHelp: Verify your current password to confirm this operation. It is never stored with the draft.
passwordFailed: Password verification failed. Try again; the payment has not been confirmed by this attempt.
freshRequired: Verify your current password before confirming.
storage: The draft or retry reference could not be saved on this device. Enable session storage before confirming; keep the current terms open.
loadFailed: Records could not be loaded. Retry; this is not an empty result.
unknown: The outcome could not be confirmed. Retry the same confirmation to recover the retained result.
denied: Your current organization, role or session no longer permits this operation. Ask the administrator to review access or sign in again.
independent: A different authorized approver must review this request.
evidence: Retained request or approval evidence needs review. Ask the finance controller to investigate; do not recreate approval evidence.
stale: The source records changed. Refresh and review the current terms before confirming again.
conflict: This reference belongs to a different recorded decision. Inspect the retained request before proceeding.
invalid: Complete the supplier, approved destination, date, supporting document, exact hash and positive invoice amounts. Use at most two decimal places and one allocation per invoice.
conditions: A source or payment condition no longer permits this operation. Refresh the records and check the supplier, destination and invoice balances.
